summary: Iter65 — Backend regression for Fixing_Prompt v3 Category→Subcategory→Product→Storage cascade. Wrote /app/backend/tests/test_warehouse_cascade.py with 15 tests spanning products-filter, cascade persistence on aisle+rack, cascade validation (a-d), location assignment enforcement, untagged back-compat, and darkstore isolation. Result: 5 passed / 10 errored due to TWO critical backend bugs in _validate_category_cascade() (routes.py:981-1025) that fire on ANY tagged Aisle create. Frontend NOT tested because backend cascade endpoint is unusable — all frontend flows that call POST /partner/warehouse/{wh}/nodes with a category_slug will 500.

critical.issue: 500 Internal Server Error — sqlalchemy MultipleResultsFound. _validate_category_cascade at routes.py:1000 does `select(MartCategory).where(MartCategory.slug == category_slug).scalar_one_or_none()` but mart_categories has UniqueConstraint('slug','country') → 3 rows per slug (CI/IN/LR) in seed. Must filter by partner.country. Same defect for MartSubcategory at line 1006.

After bug#1 is fixed, will still fail: routes.py:1013 reads `getattr(sub, 'category_slug', None)` but MartSubcategory model has NO category_slug column (only category_id + country + slug — see core/models/mart.py:43-56). So the check `sub.category_slug != category_slug` is ALWAYS `None != <slug>` → every valid (fruits-vegetables, fresh-fruits) pair raises invalid_cascade. Fix: join MartSubcategory→MartCategory and compare cat.slug, or store category_slug on MartSubcategory.

action_items: Fix _validate_category_cascade() in /app/backend/modules/mart_partner/routes.py (~line 981): scope MartCategory + MartSubcategory lookups by partner.country (pass `partner` in, add `.where(MartCategory.country == partner.country)`).

Fix subcategory→category ownership check at routes.py:1013: MartSubcategory has no category_slug attr; either add join to MartCategory and compare .slug, or resolve via MartSubcategory.category_id → MartCategory row.

Same defects exist in inventory_routes.py assign_location cascade check ONLY at the read-side (uses Aisle/Rack.category_slug which are stored strings — that's fine). Verified with the untagged-branch test which passes.
Once fixed, re-run `python -m pytest backend/tests/test_warehouse_cascade.py -v -o addopts=''` — should go 15/15 green with no other changes.
Frontend UI not yet exercised (blocked by backend). After backend fix, retest ProductsPage cascading filters + WarehouseEditor category selects + LocationModal tree filter.
critical_code_review_comments: _validate_category_cascade lacks country scoping — mart_categories/mart_subcategories are per-country. Signature should accept `country` (or a `Partner`) and filter every lookup.

MartSubcategory has `category_id`, not `category_slug`. The current cascade check silently compares `None != slug` and would reject every valid pair the moment the MultipleResults bug is fixed. Add a proper join or store a denormalised category_slug on MartSubcategory.

The Aisle/Rack cascade fields on the row itself are freeform strings — no FK integrity guarantees the category_slug still exists after country delete. Consider FK to (country, slug) or validation at boot.
assign_location correctly guards with `if p_cat and prod_cat` (untagged back-compat verified by test_untagged_aisle_rack_still_accepts_any_product ✓).

rca of the issue: ROOT CAUSE 1 — routes.py:998-1001 SELECTs MartCategory by slug alone. mart_categories has UniqueConstraint(slug,country) — 3 rows exist per slug in seed (CI/IN/LR). scalar_one_or_none() therefore raises MultipleResultsFound → 500. ROOT CAUSE 2 — routes.py:1013 references MartSubcategory.category_slug, but the ORM model (core/models/mart.py:43-56) only has category_id + country + slug. getattr(sub, 'category_slug', None) is always None, so once bug#1 is resolved every valid category+subcategory tuple will erroneously be rejected as invalid_cascade. REPRODUCTION: POST /api/partner/warehouse/wh_alpha_demo_seed/nodes with body {level:aisle, parent_id:<zone>, code:X, name:Y, category_slug:'fruits-vegetables', subcategory_slug:'fresh-fruits'} → 500. Untagged variant → 201. MITIGATION: (a) pass partner into helper, scope both lookups with `and .country == partner.country`; (b) resolve subcategory ownership via a join `SELECT MartSubcategory JOIN MartCategory ON category_id=id WHERE MartSubcategory.slug=? AND MartCategory.country=?` and compare MartCategory.slug.
